bytes_in.description: The number of bytes sent from the destination to the source. Counts bytes in Layer 3 (Network Layer) packets, including IP header and payload.
bytes_in.caption: Bytes In

bytes_out.description: The number of bytes sent from the source to the destination. Counts bytes in Layer 3 (Network Layer) packets, including IP header and payload.
bytes_out.caption: Bytes Out

chunks.description: The total number of chunks transferred in both directions (sum of chunks_in and chunks_out).
chunks.caption: Chunks

bytes.description: The total number of bytes transferred in both directions (sum of bytes_in and bytes_out). Counts bytes in Layer 3 (Network Layer) packets, including IP header and payload.
bytes.caption: Total Bytes

start_time.description: The start time of the observation or reporting period.
start_time.caption: Start Time

end_time.description: The end time of the observation or reporting period.
end_time.caption: End Time

start_time_dt.description: The start time of the observation or reporting period.
start_time_dt.caption: Start Time

end_time_dt.description: The end time of the observation or reporting period.
end_time_dt.caption: End Time

bytes_missed.description: The number of bytes that were missed during observation, typically due to packet loss or sampling limitations. Counts bytes in Layer 3 (Network Layer) packets, including IP header and payload.
bytes_missed.caption: Bytes Missed

chunks_in.description: The number of chunks sent from the destination to the source (inbound direction).
chunks_in.caption: Chunks In

chunks_out.description: The number of chunks sent from the source to the destination (outbound direction).
chunks_out.caption: Chunks Out

data_bytes.description: The total number of data bytes transferred in both directions (sum of data_bytes_in and data_bytes_out). Counts the data carried by the Layer 4 (Transport Layer) protocol, excluding the IP header and the transport header (such as TCP, UDP, etc.). Not applicable to protocols carried directly over IP without a transport header, such as ICMP, ICMPv6, IGMP, GRE, ESP and OSPF: leave it unset for those flows, whose bytes are counted by bytes, bytes_in and bytes_out.
data_bytes.caption: Total Data Bytes

data_bytes_in.description: The number of data bytes sent from the destination to the source. Counts the data carried by the Layer 4 (Transport Layer) protocol, excluding the IP header and the transport header (such as TCP, UDP, etc.). Not applicable to protocols carried directly over IP without a transport header, such as ICMP, ICMPv6, IGMP, GRE, ESP and OSPF: leave it unset for those flows, whose bytes are counted by bytes, bytes_in and bytes_out.
data_bytes_in.caption: Data Bytes In

data_bytes_out.description: The number of data bytes sent from the source to the destination. Counts the data carried by the Layer 4 (Transport Layer) protocol, excluding the IP header and the transport header (such as TCP, UDP, etc.). Not applicable to protocols carried directly over IP without a transport header, such as ICMP, ICMPv6, IGMP, GRE, ESP and OSPF: leave it unset for those flows, whose bytes are counted by bytes, bytes_in and bytes_out.
data_bytes_out.caption: Data Bytes Out

packets.description: The total number of packets transferred in both directions (sum of packets_in and packets_out).
packets.caption: Total Packets

packets_in.description: The number of packets sent from the destination to the source (inbound direction).
packets_in.caption: Packets In

packets_out.description: The number of packets sent from the source to the destination (outbound direction).
packets_out.caption: Packets Out

timespan.description: The time span object representing the duration of the observation or reporting period.
timespan.caption: Time Span

name: network_traffic
description: The Network Traffic object describes characteristics of network traffic over a time period. The metrics represent network data transferred between source and destination during an observation window.
caption: Network Traffic
